edits.new:
from pagination import paginate


def test_page_two_size_two_returns_third_and_fourth():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_page_one_returns_first_size_elements():
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 2) == [1, 2]
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 3) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_page_beyond_last_returns_empty_list():
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 4, 2) == []
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 100, 2) == []


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_list():
    assert paginate([], 1, 2) == []
    assert paginate([], 2, 2) == []


def test_invalid_page_or_size_returns_empty_list():
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 0, 2) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], -1, 2) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 1, 0) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 1, -2) == []


def test_returns_list_and_does_not_mutate_input():
    items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    snapshot = list(items)
    result = paginate(items, 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert items == snapshot

patches.rationale: The current paginate uses zero-based slicing (start = page * page_size), so page=2, size=2 on range(1,8) returns [5,6] instead of [3,4]. Fix: compute start = (page - 1) * page_size so page numbers are one-based. Keep the guard for page < 1 or page_size < 1 returning [], and slicing naturally returns [] beyond the last page. Signature and return type unchanged; input is not mutated. Add a new regression test file tests/test_pagination_regression.py covering the stated contracts.

repair_feedback.instruction: Compare the observed assertion with the ORIGINAL issue. Correct source or an unjustified NEW test; existing tests stay immutable.
